DXC issue #708 -- RegisterOffset is being ignored
https://github.com/microsoft/DirectXShaderCompiler/issues/708

WHAT TO LOOK FOR

This compiles cleanly: no error, no warning. That is the bug.

In the output, find the "Resource Bindings" table:

    ; Name          Type     Format   Dim   ID   HLSL Bind   Count
    ; tex           texture  f32      2d    T0   t1          1
                                                 ^^

"HLSL Bind" reads t1. The [27] offset written in register(t1[27]) has
been silently discarded -- it is parsed, then never used.

What the binding *should* be is an open question (this form is not
documented for SRVs). The defect being shown here is narrower: DXC
accepts the syntax and drops it without saying anything.

Both DXC versions agree, so this is long-standing, not a recent change.

The third pane is Clang, which is where HLSL support is being rebuilt.
It does not accept the syntax at all:

    error: expected ')'

That is a parse rejection rather than a considered diagnostic, but it
does mean the silent-acceptance behaviour is specific to DXC, and that
"reject it outright" is already the de facto answer in the new
front end.
